assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints derived from repository-cleared public material.
assumptions.impact: All site-specific geometry and calculated area/ratio metrics must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, height, density, setback, road-redline and parcel controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity will be calibrated against statutory planning controls; current massing supports concept review.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, ownership, heritage controls and utilities are not present as authoritative GIS layers.
assumptions.impact: Retain, renovate and renewal classifications will be determined after the required surveys and assessments.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual slow routes and crossings require coordination with official road, rail, fire-access and traffic models.
assumptions.impact: Current alignments define the intended network and will be refined through professional review.

assumptions.statement: Every AI service must use opt-in participation, data minimisation, human override and a non-digital service path.
assumptions.impact: A scenario pauses or exits if these safeguards cannot be independently audited.

assumptions.statement: Projects, operators and phases are proposals rather than public commitments.
assumptions.impact: Implementation requires statutory review, ownership coordination, financing and public participation.

assumptions.statement: OSM features are community-maintained; the 2026-08-08 extract is used for urban texture and network analysis.
assumptions.impact: Statutory decisions will use authoritative GIS and field verification; the current context supports concept orientation.

assumptions.statement: NASA POWER values are gridded/reanalysis-derived daily data for one corridor-centroid point during 2015-2024.
assumptions.impact: They inform concept-stage priorities, while drainage, wind, thermal comfort and energy sizing require local monitoring and engineering models.

assumptions.statement: Blender and image-generation scenes communicate spatial intent and atmosphere; people, planting maturity, materials and building form are illustrative.
assumptions.impact: Construction, heritage, ownership and existing-condition records will follow approved documents and professional surveys.
